description: This file contains low-level I/O routines for hardware register access, including inline functions for reading and writing 8-bit, 16-bit, and 32-bit values in little-endian and big-endian formats, along with synchronization primitives. It is intended for direct hardware interaction on PowerPC architecture within embedded or kernel code.

methods.name: uint8_t in_8(const volatile uint8_t * addr)
methods.description: Reads an 8-bit value from a hardware register using inline assembly.

methods.name: void out_8(volatile uint8_t * addr,uint8_t val)
methods.description: Writes an 8-bit value to a hardware register using inline assembly.

methods.name: uint16_t in_le16(const volatile uint16_t * addr)
methods.description: Reads a 16-bit little-endian value from a hardware register.

methods.name: uint16_t in_be16(const volatile uint16_t * addr)
methods.description: Reads a 16-bit big-endian value from a hardware register.

methods.name: void out_le16(volatile uint16_t * addr,uint16_t val)
methods.description: Writes a 16-bit little-endian value to a hardware register.

methods.name: void out_be16(volatile uint16_t * addr,uint16_t val)
methods.description: Writes a 16-bit big-endian value to a hardware register.

methods.name: uint32_t in_le32(const volatile uint32_t * addr)
methods.description: Reads a 32-bit little-endian value from a hardware register.

methods.name: uint32_t in_be32(const volatile uint32_t * addr)
methods.description: Reads a 32-bit big-endian value from a hardware register.

methods.name: void out_le32(volatile uint32_t * addr,uint32_t val)
methods.description: Writes a 32-bit little-endian value to a hardware register.

methods.name: void out_be32(volatile uint32_t * addr,uint32_t val)
methods.description: Writes a 32-bit big-endian value to a hardware register.

methods.name: void sync(void)
methods.description: Issues a sync instruction to ensure memory operations complete.

methods.name: void eieio(void)
methods.description: Issues an 'eieio' instruction for ordering in PowerPC.
